units.leftText: The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem. Hear, you peoples, all of you!
units.rightText: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah — what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem: Hear, O peoples, all of you;

units.leftText: For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, The mountains melt under him,
units.rightText: For behold, the LORD comes forth The mountains will melt beneath Him,

units.leftText: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field,
units.rightText: All this is for the transgression of Jacob Therefore I will make Samaria

units.leftText: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, For this I will lament and wail.
units.rightText: All her carved images will be smashed to pieces; Because of this I will lament and wail;

units.leftText: For her wounds are incurable; Don’t tell it in Gath.
units.rightText: For her wound is incurable; Do not tell it in Gath; do not weep at all.

units.leftText: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good,
units.rightText: Depart in shameful nakedness, For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good,

units.leftText: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath.
units.rightText: Harness your chariot horses, Therefore, send farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath;

units.leftText: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. Shave your heads,
units.rightText: I will again bring a conqueror against you, Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair

units.leftText: Woe to those who devise iniquity They covet fields and seize them,
units.rightText: Woe to those who devise iniquity They covet fields and seize them;

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD says: In that day they will take up a parable against you,
units.rightText: Therefore this is what the LORD says: In that day they will take up a proverb against you

units.leftText: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly. “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy—
units.rightText: Therefore, you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD “Do not preach,” they preach.

units.leftText: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, But lately my people have risen up as an enemy.
units.rightText: Should it be said, O house of Jacob, But of late My people have risen up

units.leftText: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; Arise, and depart!
units.rightText: You drive the women of My people Arise and depart,

units.leftText: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob.
units.rightText: If a man of wind were to come I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob;

units.leftText: I said, You who hate the good,
units.rightText: Then I said: You hate good and love evil.

units.leftText: who also eat the flesh of my people, Then they will cry to the LORD,
units.rightText: You eat the flesh of my people Then they will cry out to the LORD,

units.leftText: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision,
units.rightText: This is what the LORD says: Therefore night will come over you without visions,

units.leftText: The seers shall be disappointed, But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit,
units.rightText: Then the seers will be ashamed As for me, however, I am filled with power

units.leftText: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, who build up Zion with blood,
units.rightText: Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob who build Zion with bloodshed

units.leftText: Her leaders judge for bribes, Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field,
units.rightText: Her leaders judge for a bribe, Therefore, because of you,

units.leftText: But in the latter days, Many nations will go and say,
units.rightText: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD And many nations will come and say:

units.leftText: and he will judge between many peoples, But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree.
units.rightText: Then He will judge between many peoples And each man will sit under his own vine

units.leftText: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, “In that day,” says the LORD,
units.rightText: Though all the nations “On that day,” declares the LORD,

units.leftText: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion,
units.rightText: And I will make the lame into a remnant, And you, O watchtower of the flock,

units.leftText: Now why do you cry out aloud? Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion,
units.rightText: Why do you now cry aloud? Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion,

units.leftText: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, But they don’t know the thoughts of the LORD,
units.rightText: But now many nations But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD

units.leftText: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah,
units.rightText: Now, O daughter of troops, But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah,

units.leftText: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD,
units.rightText: Therefore Israel will be abandoned He will stand and shepherd His flock

units.leftText: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword,
units.rightText: And He will be our peace And they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword,

units.leftText: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations,
units.rightText: Then the remnant of Jacob will be Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations,

units.leftText: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, “It will happen in that day”, says the LORD,
units.rightText: Your hand will be lifted over your foes, “In that day,”

units.leftText: I will cut off the cities of your land I will destroy witchcraft from your hand.
units.rightText: I will remove the cities of your land I will cut the sorceries from your hand,

units.leftText: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you;
units.rightText: I will also cut off the carved images I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst

units.leftText: Listen now to what the LORD says: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment,
units.rightText: Hear now what the LORD says: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment,

units.leftText: My people, what have I done to you? For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt,
units.rightText: ‘My people, what have I done to you? For I brought you up from the land of Egypt

units.leftText: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, How shall I come before the LORD,
units.rightText: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled With what shall I come before the LORD

units.leftText: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? He has shown you, O man, what is good.
units.rightText: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, He has shown you, O man, what is good.

units.leftText: The LORD’s voice calls to the city— Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked,
units.rightText: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city Can I forget any longer,

units.leftText: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, Her rich men are full of violence,
units.rightText: Can I excuse dishonest scales For the wealthy of the city

units.leftText: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. You shall eat, but not be satisfied.
units.rightText: Therefore I am striking you severely, You will eat but not be satisfied,

units.leftText: You will sow, but won’t reap. For the statutes of Omri are kept,
units.rightText: You will sow but not reap; You have kept the statutes of Omri

units.leftText: Misery is mine! The godly man has perished out of the earth,
units.rightText: Woe is me! The godly man has perished from the earth;

units.leftText: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The best of them is like a brier.
units.rightText: Both hands are skilled at evil; The best of them is like a brier;

units.leftText: Don’t trust in a neighbor. For the son dishonors the father,
units.rightText: Do not rely on a friend; For a son dishonors his father,

units.leftText: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy.
units.rightText: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; Do not gloat over me, my enemy!

units.leftText: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, Then my enemy will see it,
units.rightText: Because I have sinned against Him, Then my enemy will see

units.leftText: A day to build your walls! In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt,
units.rightText: The day for rebuilding your walls will come — On that day they will come to you

units.leftText: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, Shepherd your people with your staff,
units.rightText: Then the earth will become desolate Shepherd with Your staff Your people,

units.leftText: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might.
units.rightText: As in the days when you came out of Egypt, Nations will see and be ashamed,

units.leftText: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity,
units.rightText: They will lick the dust like a snake, Who is a God like You,

units.leftText: He will again have compassion on us. You will give truth to Jacob,
units.rightText: He will again have compassion on us; You will show faithfulness to Jacob
